snapshot_next_report.first_output:
The big divergence on your watchlist today is in memory and storage, where WDC and STX jumped 5.6% and 4.6% while SNDK and MU stayed flat to down. That's a company-by-company split rather than a theme moving together. Elsewhere, your AI compute names tracked each other higher — TSM, NVDA and AVGO all up 2.1% to 2.8% — except AMD, which sat out the move at -0.2%. Mega-cap tech mostly climbed in line with the Nasdaq's 0.9% gain, though AAPL lagged at -0.3%. CEG rose 4.1% while the rest of your power and infrastructure names held near flat.

Outside your watchlist, PTC jumped 34% and Brazilian fintech names XP, PAGS, INTR and STNE all rallied 20% or more today.

TSM reports in 10 days, followed by TSLA and VRT in 16, then STX in 22. The week of November 24 has a cluster: GOOGL, META, MSFT report that day, then AAPL, AMZN and SNDK the day after.
